events.summary: PUBLIC ACCESS GRANTED Today marks the official reveal of NODE ZERO, the first project from independent game studio Static State. What begins as a routine Initialization Process quickly becomes something far more dangerous. An intelligence known only as ZERO is growing inside the system.
